title: Gehlee Dangca's debut solo single ‘Closer’ MV surpasses 1 million views

blocks.text: Former K-pop artist Gehlee Dangca, who is among the “Pinoy Big Brother: Collab 3.0” housemates, received overwhelming support for her debut solo single “Closer,” with its official music video garnering over 1.4 million views so far. Released last Oct. 23 under Universal Records Philippines, the track marked the launch of Dangca’s solo music career following the conclusion of her activities with her former K-pop girl group, UNIS. As of Tuesday, Nov. 3, the music video has reached 1,428,761 views. Dangca also performed a snippet of her new single inside the “PBB” house alongside her fellow female housemates.
